parole.significato: to give the lie, refute, contradict
parole.testo: Altered, influenced by German Lügen strafen, from earlier loghenstroopen (1588), which in turn can be traced back to Middle Dutch loghenstrepen. By surface analysis, logen + straffen.

parole.significato: to brush (usually with a flat brush)
parole.testo: First attested in the 16th century. Borrowed from German scheuern, itself probably from Middle Dutch schuren. In any case a doublet of schuren, which see.
